service.description: Make a skill Active and mark it human-reviewed. Only human-reviewed skills can set a risk of reversible that skips the confirmation click, so the reviewer picks the risk here.

parameter.name: riskId
parameter.description: LskReversible, LskConfirm or LskIrreversible. Blank keeps the current risk.

service.description: Retire oldSkillId in favor of newSkillId. The new skill records which one it replaced.
Edit the text of a skill and bump its version. Status and provenance do not change, so an edited skill still goes through approval.

parameter.name: kind
parameter.description: procedure or reference. Blank leaves it unchanged.

parameter.name: statusId
parameter.description: LsksActive makes it appear in the skill's prompt. LsksRejected hides it.

service.description: Which skills the agent would retrieve for a request, with scores and the text injected into the prompt.

actions.script: import org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmAdmin def result = LlmAdmin.retrieveSkills(ec, query ?: "", limit ?: 15) skills = result.skills injectText = result.injectText

service.description: Delete a conversation with its messages and call logs. A Streaming conversation must be cancelled first.
Effective profile configuration with credentials removed, plus the runtime switches set outside profiles.

actions.script: import org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmAdmin profileDetailList = LlmAdmin.profileDetails(ec) runtimeSwitches = LlmAdmin.runtimeSwitches()

service.description: Send one tiny request through a profile. It makes a real provider call, so it can cost a little and counts toward the tarpit.

actions.script: import org.moqui.impl.llm.LlmAdmin def r = LlmAdmin.testProfile(ec, profileName) ok = r.ok; content = r.content; model = r.model; finishReason = r.finishReason error = r.error; httpStatus = r.httpStatus; durationMs = r.durationMs
